This complex geopolitical and technological landscape is compounded by persistent physical threats, underscored by a cluster of recent M5+ seismic events across critical global regions. To navigate this period, immediately secure diversified and resilient supply chains for essential resources, significantly bolster digital defenses and review AI dependencies against advanced cyber threats, and harden physical infrastructure and preparedness plans for natural disasters in at-risk areas.
